resources.string: Read the open page, gather data from it, scroll, tap and fill in fields
Open tabs, run searches, show and close tabs
Search history, bookmarks, downloads and files on the phone
Carry actions out straight away, without asking every time

The assistant will be able to press buttons, fill in forms, add bookmarks and close tabs without your permission. Turn this on only if you trust the model that is answering. You can turn it off again at any time.
Turn any item off and the matching tools are simply never offered to the model. Passwords and payment details are out of the assistant\'s reach under every setting.
